actions.openInbox.label: Open RFQ inbox
errors.RFQ_NOT_QUOTED: This action is not available for the quote request in its current state.
errors.RFQ_EXPIRED: This quote is no longer valid — its validity period has ended. Ask your sales representative for a new quote, or submit the request again.
errors.RFQ_PRICE_PROPOSAL_NOT_ALLOWED: Your account cannot propose prices on quote requests. Remove the proposed prices and send the request again — sales will price it.
errors.QUOTE_INCOMPLETE: This quote request has a line with no agreed price. The seller must price every line before the request can be accepted, approved or ordered.
errors.QUOTE_VALIDITY_ENDED: The accepted quote is no longer valid — its validity period has ended. Ask your sales representative for a new quote before ordering.
errors.RFQ_SAVED_VIEW_NAME_TAKEN: You already have a saved view with this name on the quote request list. Choose a different name.

negotiation.title: Price negotiation on quote requests
negotiation.organization.label: Members may propose prices
negotiation.organization.description: When this is off, customers of this organization send quote requests without proposed prices and sales prices every line. A customer account can override this value on its own screen.
negotiation.customer.label: Price proposals for this customer
negotiation.customer.description: Overrides the organization value for this customer account only. Choose "As organization" to follow the organization.
negotiation.loadError: Could not load the price negotiation setting.
negotiation.saveError: Could not save the price negotiation setting. The previous value is kept.
